summary: Intercont (Cayman) Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of a Class A meeting and an extraordinary general meeting held on June 5, 2026. Shareholders approved an increase in authorized share capital from $50,000 to $250,000,000 by creating 80 billion Class A and 20 billion Class B ordinary shares, and changed Class B voting rights from 30 to 100 votes per share. These are routine capital structure amendments with no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or special situation component.
